messages:
Alex: Quick favor — can someone run a mini hardware bakeoff tonight? Need A100 / H100 / L40S comparison for batch-size sensitivity (batch=1,8,32) on rwdb-webqa-13b. Focus on p50/p95/p99, power draw, thermal throttling flags, and kernel fallback counts. Use Q4_0 quant. Two sequence lengths: 512 and 2048. Run both single-stream and multi-stream configs. Tag results with bench-id mini-thermal-202603 and upload raw logs + csv to /bench-results/mini-thermal. No need for full histograms beyond p50/p95/p99. Thanks.

Maria: I can take this tonight. Which kernel/driver + model commit should I pin to?

Alex: Use Ubuntu 22.04, nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.2. Pin runtime branch perf/mini-bakeoff and model commit abc123def. Use runtime flags: --batch-sizes 1,8,32 --quant Q4_0 --seq-lens 512,2048. Please also collect nvml power samples.

Sam: Add KV warmup check: run cold-start (no cache) then a warm run after 3 prefixes. Also include a microbench for batch=1 seq=128 to catch tiny-batch noise. I'll drop a harness script (mini-sweep.py) into the bench repo.

Jia: Please add me as reviewer on the PR that creates the bench job. Also can @bench-bot create a checklist/ticket so we don't miss power logs.

bench-bot: created bench ticket BENCH-4572 -> checklist: config file, raw logs, csv perf summary, nvml power logs, perf traces, kernel list. Uploads to s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/<run-id> and post dashboard link when done.

Kevin: If you see any thermal throttling on H100, run a quick rerun on dedicated-dpool-2 to rule out scheduling interference.

Maria: Kicked off A100 run for batch=1,8,32 seq=512 (single-stream) on node gpu-a100-07. Runtime job id: run-2401-a100-1. ETA ~2h. I'll post links as they appear.

Maria: quick heads-up — observed a cudnn heuristic kernel fallback on A100 for the tiny-batch path (batch=1). Dumping kernel list to s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/a100/kernel-list-run-2401.txt. Also captured nvml power trace.

Alex: Good catch. If you hit p99>2000ms on L40S for batch=32 abort that run and re-run with batch=16 (we expect L40S to struggle at batch32 for seq2048).

Sam: When logs land can you include env dump (GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY, OMP_NUM_THREADS), and the exact runtime flags? Also attach perf script output (cycles, LLC-misses) for the long-tail cases.

Maria: Added env dump and perf traces to the S3 path. CSV summary: s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/a100/summary-run-2401.csv

Jia: Dashboard link (will be filled by bench-bot): https://pharos.internal/bench/BENCH-4572 — I'll pin this in the channel. Also set alert if p99 delta between A100 and H100 > 20%.

bench-bot: SUMMARY for BENCH-4572 (partial): A100-run-2401 done. p50=120ms p95=430ms p99=820ms (seq512, batch1/8/32 aggregated). Kernel fallback=1 event for tiny-batch. Next: H100 run queued, L40S scheduled after H100.

Kevin: If H100 looks too warm, let's capture chassis-level temp (IPMI) and GPU inlet temps to correlate.

Maria: H100 run started on gpu-h100-02 (run-2401-h100-1). nvml and ipmi tracing enabled. ETA ~2h.

Sam: I'll grab the perf traces once both runs finish and start an initial comparison. Will look for microburst patterns in the p95->p99 window.

Maria: All logs uploaded: A100 -> s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/a100/, H100 -> s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/h100/, L40S -> s3://bench-raw/mini-thermal/l40s/ (L40S run retried with batch16 per Alex's note). CSVs and perf traces present.

bench-bot: posted dashboard: https://pharos.internal/bench/BENCH-4572/results (summary + raw links). Bench ticket updated to 'results ready'.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll do a quick pass tomorrow morning and open a follow-up if we need deeper kernel-level profiling. If anyone sees a surprising power curve pls @me and attach the csv.

Maria: Cool, will add notes to BENCH-4572 for follow-ups (thermal investigation / kernel fallback root cause).
